entries.title: Psalms 74:1
segments: ¶<<A Contemplation of Asaph.>> O God, why have You cast [us] off forever? [Why] does Your anger smoke against the sheep of Your pasture?

entries.title: Psalms 74:2
segments: Remember Your congregation, [which] You have purchased of old, The tribe of Your inheritance, [which] You have redeemed-This Mount Zion where You have dwelt.

entries.title: Psalms 74:3
segments: Lift up Your feet to the perpetual desolations. The enemy has damaged everything in the sanctuary.

entries.title: Psalms 74:4
segments: Your enemies roar in the midst of Your meeting place; They set up their banners [for] signs.

entries.title: Psalms 74:5
segments: They seem like men who lift up Axes among the thick trees.

entries.title: Psalms 74:6
segments: And now they break down its carved work, all at once, With axes and hammers.

entries.title: Psalms 74:7
segments: They have set fire to Your sanctuary; They have defiled the dwelling place of Your name to the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 74:8
segments: They said in their hearts, "Let us destroy them altogether." They have burned up all the meeting places of God in the land.

entries.title: Psalms 74:9
segments: We do not see our signs; [There is] no longer any prophet; Nor [is there] any among us who knows how long.

entries.title: Psalms 74:10
segments: O God, how long will the adversary reproach? Will the enemy blaspheme Your name forever?

entries.title: Psalms 74:11
segments: Why do You withdraw Your hand, even Your right hand? [Take it] out of Your bosom and destroy [them].

entries.title: Psalms 74:12
segments: ¶For God [is] my King from of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 74:13
segments: You divided the sea by Your strength; You broke the heads of the sea serpents in the waters.

entries.title: Psalms 74:14
segments: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces, [And] gave him [as] food to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

entries.title: Psalms 74:15
segments: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up mighty rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 74:16
segments: The day [is] Yours, the night also [is] Yours; You have prepared the light and the sun.

entries.title: Psalms 74:17
segments: You have set all the borders of the earth; You have made summer and winter.

entries.title: Psalms 74:18
segments: ¶Remember this, [that] the enemy has reproached, O LORD, And [that] a foolish people has blasphemed Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 74:19
segments: Oh, do not deliver the life of Your turtledove to the wild beast! Do not forget the life of Your poor forever.

entries.title: Psalms 74:20
segments: Have respect to the covenant; For the dark places of the earth are full of the haunts of cruelty.

entries.title: Psalms 74:21
segments: Oh, do not let the oppressed return ashamed! Let the poor and needy praise Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 74:22
segments: Arise, O God, plead Your own cause; Remember how the foolish man reproaches You daily.

entries.title: Psalms 74:23
segments: Do not forget the voice of Your enemies; The tumult of those who rise up against You increases continually.
